description: Defines the 'Column' class representing a table column in the MigraDoc Document Object Model, including properties, cloning, serialization, and internal value management.

classes.name: Column
classes.description: Represents a table column with properties for styling, sizing, and serialization.

classes.name: Column.ColumnValues
classes.description: Internal class holding nullable property values for a Column instance.

methods.name: Clone
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of the Column object.

methods.name: DeepCopy
methods.description: Performs the deep copy operation, cloning nested objects.

methods.name: ResetCachedValues
methods.description: Resets cached internal values and references.

methods.name: Serialize
methods.description: Serializes the Column object into a DDL format.
